    10	
    11	For a sheaf `F` of `R`-modules on a small site, this file introduces the two numeric
    12	invariants `h⁰ F = finrank R H⁰(F)` and `h¹ F = finrank R H¹(F)` (with `Hⁱ` the `Ext`-based
    13	cohomology carrier `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule`) and the truncated Euler characteristic
    14	
    15	    χ F = h⁰ F − h¹ F  (in ℤ).
    16	
    17	Nothing here is scheme-specific: the definitions and their transport along sheaf
    18	isomorphisms live at the level of an arbitrary small site with `R`-module coefficients.
    19	The Riemann–Roch lane instantiates them at the small Zariski site of a curve, where all
    20	higher cohomology vanishes and the truncation is the honest Euler characteristic.
    21

    23	
    24	* `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv`: the `R`-linear equivalence `Hⁿ(F) ≃ₗ[R] Hⁿ(G)`

    26	  legs of the isomorphism).

    28	  ledger invariants.
    29	* `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h0_congr` / `h1_congr` / `chi_congr`: invariance under sheaf
    30	  isomorphism.
    31	* `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.h1_eq_zero` / `chi_eq_h0`: degenerate forms when `H¹(F)`
    32	  vanishes (e.g. skyscrapers, affine schemes).

    35	finiteness hypothesis is imposed here (`finrank` silently reads `0` on infinite-dimensional

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]

/-- Phase A step 5 main, helper (1): the ring map `k → Γ(C, U)` induced by the
structure morphism `C.hom : C.left ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)` and the
restriction along `U ≤ ⊤`. -/
noncomputable def kToSection (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ) :
    (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ C.left.presheaf.obj U :=
  (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
    C.hom.app ⊤ ≫ C.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op

/-- Phase A step 5 main, helper (2): `Γ(C, U)` is a `k`-algebra via the ring
map of `kToSection`. -/
noncomputable instance algebraSection (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ) :
    Algebra k (C.left.presheaf.obj U) :=
  RingHom.toAlgebra (kToSection C U).hom

/-- Phase A step 5 main, helper (3): unfolding lemma for the algebra map. -/
lemma algebraMap_eq_kToSection (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (U : (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ) :
    (algebraMap k (C.left.presheaf.obj U)) = (kToSection C U).hom :=
  rfl

/-- Phase A step 5 main, helper (4): the structure-morphism algebra map is
natural in `U`. -/
lemma kToSection_naturality (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    {U V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) :
    kToSection C U ≫ C.left.presheaf.map f = kToSection C V := by
  simp only [kToSection, Category.assoc, ← C.left.presheaf.map_comp]
  rfl

/-- Phase A step 5 main, helper (5): corollary of (4) at the level of
`algebraMap`. -/
lemma algebraMap_naturality (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    {U V : (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) (r : k) :
    (C.left.presheaf.map f).hom (algebraMap k (C.left.presheaf.obj U) r)
      = algebraMap k (C.left.presheaf.obj V) r := by
  rw [algebraMap_eq_kToSection, algebraMap_eq_kToSection]
  exact congrArg (fun (g : (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ _) => g.hom r)
    (kToSection_naturality (C := C) f)

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.toModuleKSheaf

    (TopologicalSpace.Opens C.left.toTopCat)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
  obj U := ModuleCat.of k (C.left.presheaf.obj U)

    11	For the curve bundle `X` over a field `K`, a Weil divisor is a finitely supported

    10	# Closed points of a curve: valuation order and residue degree
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` smooth of relative dimension one over a field `K` and integral (the curve
    13	bundle of the Jacobian challenge), every non-generic point `x` is closed, its local ring
    14	`𝒪_{X,x}` is a discrete valuation ring, and it carries:
    15	
    16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk` / `isDedekindDomain_stalk`: the DVR /
    17	  Dedekind structure on the stalk at a closed point;
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord`: the `ℤᵐ⁰`-valued valuation of the function field determined
    19	  by the closed point (the order of vanishing of a rational function at `x`);
    20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residueDeg`: the residue degree `[κ(x) : K]`, the `K`-dimension of
    21	  the residue field, together with (in a later section) its finiteness and positivity.
    22	
    23	The `K`-module structure on the residue field is carried by the explicit ring homomorphism
    24	`Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap` (through the structure morphism), never a global `Algebra`
    25	instance, mirroring the `Scheme.overModule` discipline of `Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf`.
    26	-/

    40	/-- **DVR at a closed point of an affine Dedekind chart.** If `x` lies in an affine open with
    41	Dedekind section ring and is not the generic point of the (irreducible) scheme, its stalk is a
    42	discrete valuation ring: the localization of a Dedekind domain at a nonzero prime. -/
    43	theorem IsAffineOpen.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk [IsIntegral X] {V : X.Opens}
    44	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hD : IsDedekindDomain Γ(X, V)) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ V)
    45	    (hxg : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    46	    IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    47	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    48	  have hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal :=
    49	    hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
    50	  set q := hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩ with hq
    51	  have hbot : q.asIdeal ≠ ⊥ := by
    52	    intro h
    53	    apply hxg
    54	    have h1 : hV.fromSpec.base q = x := hV.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩
    55	    have hgen : (genericPoint (Spec Γ(X, V)) : Spec Γ(X, V)) = q := by
    56	      rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
    57	      exact (PrimeSpectrum.ext h).symm
    58	    rw [← h1, ← hgen, genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion hV.fromSpec]
    59	  exact IsLocalization.AtPrime.isDiscreteValuationRing_of_dedekind_domain Γ(X, V) hbot _
    60	
    61	/-- **DVR at a closed point of a smooth curve.** On an integral scheme smooth of relative
    62	dimension one over a field, the stalk at a non-generic point is a discrete valuation ring. -/
    63	theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    64	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    65	    IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) := by
    66	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hD⟩ :=
    67	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isDedekindDomain_section f x
    68	  exact hV.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk hD hxV hx

    92	/-- **The order valuation at a closed point.** The `ℤᵐ⁰`-valued valuation of the function
    93	field `K(X)` determined by the discrete valuation ring `𝒪_{X,x}` at a closed point `x`: the
    94	order of vanishing of a rational function at `x`. -/

    96	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsIntegral X] {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    97	    Valuation X.functionField (WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) := by
    98	  letI := isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk f hx
    99	  letI := isDedekindDomain_stalk f hx
   100	  exact
   101	    ({ asIdeal := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
   102	       isPrime := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal (X.presheaf.stalk x)).isPrime
   103	       ne_bot := IsDiscreteValuationRing.not_a_field (X.presheaf.stalk x) } :
   104	      IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum (X.presheaf.stalk x)).valuation X.functionField
   105	
   106	end Order

   110	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   111	
   112	/-- The `K`-algebra structure map on the residue field `κ(x)` of a scheme over `Spec K`,
   113	through the structure morphism: `K →+* Γ(X, ⊤) →+* 𝒪_{X,x} →+* κ(x)`. Deliberately not a
   114	global `Algebra` instance (same overlap hazard as `Scheme.overModule`). -/
   115	noncomputable def Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap (x : X) : K →+* X.residueField x :=
   116	  (X.residue x).hom.comp
   117	    (((X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom).comp (X.overAlgebraMap K ⊤))
   118	
   119	/-- The `K`-module structure on the residue field `κ(x)`, by restriction of scalars along
   120	`Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap`. Activate with `attribute [local instance]` where needed. -/
   121	@[reducible] noncomputable def Scheme.residueFieldOverModule (x : X) :
   122	    Module K (X.residueField x) :=
   123	  (X.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toModule

   125	attribute [local instance] Scheme.residueFieldOverModule

   127	/-- **The residue degree** `[κ(x) : K]`: the `K`-dimension of the residue field at `x`. -/
   128	noncomputable def Scheme.residueDeg (x : X) : ℕ :=
   129	  Module.finrank K (X.residueField x)
   130	
   131	end ResidueDegree

   133	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# Finiteness and positivity of the residue degree at a closed point
    10	
    11	For a scheme `X` smooth of relative dimension one over a field `K`, integral, and locally of
    12	finite type (the curve bundle of the Jacobian challenge), the residue field `κ(x)` at a
    13	non-generic (hence closed) point `x` is a *finite* extension of `K`, and its degree is
    14	positive:
    15	
    16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residueDeg_finite`: `κ(x)` is a finite `K`-module;
    17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.residueDeg_pos`: `0 < [κ(x) : K]`.
    18	
    19	The `K`-module structure on `κ(x)` is the landed `Scheme.residueFieldOverModule K X x` (restriction
    20	of scalars along the explicit ring hom `Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap`), activated as a local
    21	instance below.
    22	
    23	## Mathematical route (Zariski's lemma through a chart)
    24	
    25	A closed point `x` lies in a Dedekind affine chart `V ∋ x` with section ring `B := Γ(X, V)`; the
    26	prime `q := hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, _⟩` is nonzero, hence maximal, so `B ⧸ q` is a field. Two facts
    27	combine:
    28	
    29	1. **Finite type ⇒ finite (Zariski/Jacobson).** `K → B` is of finite type (locally of finite type
    30	   applied to the chart), so `K → B → B ⧸ q` is a finite-type map into a *field*; over the
    31	   Jacobson ring `K`, `finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing` upgrades finite type to finite.
    32	2. **`κ(x) ≅ B ⧸ q` `K`-linearly.** The stalk `𝒪_{X,x}` is the localization of `B` at `q`, so its
    33	   residue field is `q.ResidueField`; for maximal `q` this is `B ⧸ q`. Transporting the module
    34	   finiteness along this ring iso — shown `K`-linear by a compatibility of structure maps through
    35	   the chart — gives finiteness of `κ(x)`.
    36	
    37	Positivity is then `Module.finrank_pos_iff_of_free` for the nontrivial free finite module `κ(x)`
    38	over the field `K`.
    39	-/
    40	
    41	set_option autoImplicit false
    42	
    43	universe u
    44	
    45	open CategoryTheory Limits
    46	
    47	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    48	
    49	attribute [local instance] Scheme.residueFieldOverModule
    50	
    51	/-- A nonzero-prime witness at a closed point of an affine Dedekind chart: on an integral scheme
    52	with a domain section ring, the prime of `Γ(X, V)` cut out by a non-generic point of an affine open
    53	is not `⊥`. (Re-derivation of the ne-bot fact used in `IsAffineOpen.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk`.)
    54	-/
    55	private theorem primeIdealOf_ne_bot {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X] {V : X.Opens}
    56	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) [IsDomain Γ(X, V)] {x : X} (hx : x ∈ V) (hxg : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    57	    (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal ≠ ⊥ := by
    58	  intro h
    59	  apply hxg
    60	  have h1 : hV.fromSpec.base (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) = x := hV.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩
    61	  have hgen : (genericPoint (Spec Γ(X, V)) : Spec Γ(X, V)) = hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
    62	    rw [genericPoint_eq_bot_of_affine]
    63	    exact (PrimeSpectrum.ext h).symm
    64	  rw [← h1, ← hgen, genericPoint_eq_of_isOpenImmersion hV.fromSpec]
    65	
    66	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    67	
    68	/-- **Finiteness of the residue degree at a closed point.** On an integral scheme smooth of
    69	relative dimension one and locally of finite type over a field `K`, the residue field at a
    70	non-generic point is a finite `K`-module. -/
    71	theorem Scheme.residueDeg_finite
    72	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    73	    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
    74	    Module.Finite K (X.residueField x) := by
    75	  -- A Dedekind affine chart `V ∋ x`, its section ring `Γ(X, V)`, and the nonzero maximal prime `q`.
    76	  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hD⟩ :=
    77	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.exists_isDedekindDomain_section (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) x
    78	  haveI := hD
    79	  letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) (X.presheaf.stalk x) := X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
    80	  haveI hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩).asIdeal :=
    81	    hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hxV⟩
    82	  set q := hV.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxV⟩ with hq
    83	  haveI : q.asIdeal.IsPrime := q.isPrime
    84	  haveI hmax : q.asIdeal.IsMaximal := q.isPrime.isMaximal (primeIdealOf_ne_bot hV hxV hx)
    85	  letI : Field (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.field q.asIdeal
    86	  -- The residue-field ring iso `B ⧸ q ≃+* κ(x)`, from the localization and the maximal quotient.
    87	  set φ' := IsLocalization.algEquiv q.asIdeal.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    88	    (X.presheaf.stalk x) with hφ'
    89	  set m := IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv φ'.toRingEquiv with hm
    90	  set b := RingEquiv.ofBijective (algebraMap (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) q.asIdeal.ResidueField)
    91	    (Ideal.bijective_algebraMap_quotient_residueField q.asIdeal) with hb
    92	  set e' := b.trans m with he'
    93	  -- The finite-type structure map `ψ : K → B ⧸ q`.
    94	  set ψ := (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal).comp (X.overAlgebraMap K V) with hψ
    95	  -- `κ(x)` seen through the chart: `residue ∘ germ_V ∘ overAlgebraMap_V`.
    96	  have hmid : (X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap K ⊤)
    97	      = (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV).hom.comp (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
    98	    have hgr : X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial
    99	        = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op ≫ X.presheaf.germ V x hxV :=
   100	      (X.presheaf.germ_res (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)) x hxV).symm
   101	    rw [hgr, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_assoc,
   102	      X.overAlgebraMap_naturality K (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op]
   103	  have hchart : X.residueOverAlgebraMap K x
   104	      = ((X.residue x).hom.comp (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV).hom).comp (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
   105	    rw [Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap, hmid, ← RingHom.comp_assoc]
   106	  -- Core compatibility of the ring iso with the chart's residue map (no `K` involved).
   107	  have hcore : e'.toRingHom.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk q.asIdeal)
   108	      = (X.residue x).hom.comp (X.presheaf.germ V x hxV).hom := by
   109	    ext y
   110	    simp only [he', hb, hm, RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
   111	      RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.coe_ofBijective,
   112	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.mapEquiv_apply, Ideal.algebraMap_quotient_residueField_mk]
   113	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply Γ(X, V) (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
   114	        q.asIdeal.ResidueField, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq,
   115	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map_residue]
   116	    simp only [RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, AlgEquiv.coe_ringEquiv, AlgEquiv.commutes]
   117	    rfl
   118	  -- `K`-linear compatibility `e' (ψ c) = residueOverAlgebraMap c`.
   119	  have hcompat : ∀ c : K, e' (ψ c) = X.residueOverAlgebraMap K x c := fun c => by
   120	    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hcore (X.overAlgebraMap K V c)
   121	    rw [hchart]
   122	    exact h
   123	  -- Finiteness of `B ⧸ q` over `K` by Zariski's lemma (finite type into a field, Jacobson base).
   124	  letI : Algebra K (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) := ψ.toAlgebra
   125	  have hoa : (X.overAlgebraMap K V).FiniteType := by
   126	    have happ : X.overAlgebraMap K V = ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).appLE ⊤ V le_top).hom.comp
   127	        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom := by
   128	      rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp]; rfl
   129	    rw [happ]
   130	    exact RingHom.FiniteType.comp
   131	      ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hV le_top)
   132	      (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
   133	        (((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
   134	          (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv).mp inferInstance).surjective))
   135	  have hψft : ψ.FiniteType := by
   136	    rw [hψ]; exact RingHom.FiniteType.comp_surjective hoa Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
   137	  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType K (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) := hψft
   138	  have hfin : Module.Finite K (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) :=
   139	    finite_of_finite_type_of_isJacobsonRing K (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal)
   140	  -- Transport finiteness `K`-linearly along `e'`.
   141	  haveI := hfin
   142	  refine Module.Finite.of_surjective
   143	    ({ toFun := e'
   144	       map_add' := map_add e'
   145	       map_smul' := fun c z => by
   146	         simp only [RingHom.id_apply]
   147	         rw [Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, map_mul, hcompat c]
   148	         rfl } :
   149	      (Γ(X, V) ⧸ q.asIdeal) →ₗ[K] X.residueField x) e'.surjective
   150	
   151	/-- **Positivity of the residue degree at a closed point.** On an integral scheme smooth of
   152	relative dimension one and locally of finite type over a field `K`, the residue degree at a
   153	non-generic point is positive. -/
   154	theorem Scheme.residueDeg_pos
   155	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   156	    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   157	    0 < X.residueDeg K x := by
   158	  haveI := Scheme.residueDeg_finite (K := K) hx
   159	  change 0 < Module.finrank K (X.residueField x)
   160	  exact (Module.finrank_pos_iff_of_free K (X.residueField x)).mpr inferInstance
   161

theorem exists_stalk_lift_of_order_nonneg {P : X.PrimeDivisor}
    {f : X.functionField} (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (hord : 0 ≤ Scheme.RationalMap.order P f) :
    ∃ a : X.presheaf.stalk P.point,

    have : WithZero.log (pointValuation P f) ≤ WithZero.log (1 : ℤᵐ⁰) := by
